items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And then also in Boston you met Benny Waters. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Well, Pasquale, he went in and he was teaching. He was teaching up there. Yeah, he was teaching quite a few of the boys. I never heard... Let me see. At that time, I couldn't afford to pay for the lessons. It was hard enough for my Daddy to pay for the saxophone without the lessons.
And then also in Boston you met Benny Waters.
Yeah. He came up here to go to school and play music at the Conservatory.
